Row.Text: Moon Goddess
Coast and Ocean tiles in cities following this Pantheon provide +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
Goddess of Commerce
+1 [ICON_TradeRoute] Trade Route capacity. All Trade Routes provide +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
Sun God
Wheat, Rice, and Maize in cities following this Pantheon provide +2 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
Oral Tradition
Plantations in cities following this Pantheon provide +1 [ICON_Food] Food and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
Earth Spirits
Tile purchase costs are reduced by 50%.
Goddess of Gardens
Plantations in cities following this Pantheon provide +1 [ICON_Science] Science and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
Goddess of Wealth
Researching Pottery unlocks Commercial Hubs. Luxury resource tiles adjacent to a Commercial Hub in cities following this Pantheon provide +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
God of Trade
All Trade Routes provide +1 [ICON_Production] Production. Purchasing Traders costs 50% less.
Path of Conquest
Encampments and their unique replacements provide +1 [ICON_Production] Production, +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture, and +2 [ICON_Gold] Gold.
Sacred Inscriptions
Cities with a Monument or Old God Obelisk receive +3 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
God of Granaries
Cities with a Granary receive +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture, +1 [ICON_Gold] Gold, and +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
Reef Paradise
Reefs in cities following this Pantheon provide +1 [ICON_Food] Food and +1 [ICON_Culture] Culture.
Siren
Water tiles in cities following this Pantheon provide +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith.
Druid
Holy Site districts receive a standard +1 [ICON_Faith] Faith adjacency bonus from each adjacent Woods tile.
